thread:
mira-marketing: Quick update  PulseCare pilot finished yesterday. Theyre open to a case study + webinar if legal signs off. Can someone own the interview and quote collection next week? :wave:

ben-legal: I can own consent. We need written permission for quotes, logo, and any screenshots. Also confirm PR contact and embargo date.

sam-sales: PulseCare reported: ~60% inference CPU reduction and 30% lower per-request cost during the pilot. Dont publish numbers until their Eng lead confirms.

yara-product: Please capture the exact run: model family, sequence distribution, batch size, quantization. Otherwise numbers are misleading.

kevin-cs: I have the pilot dashboards and can join the call to validate metrics. Will upload screenshots to the intake doc.

mira-marketing: Draft quote option A (numbers-agnostic) and B (metrics included). Option A:

"PulseCare: Redwood made our LLM features reliable and cost-effective, enabling patient-facing responses at scale."  Nora (PulseCare)

Option B (metrics included) drafted but will hold until they confirm on the call.

nora-pulsecare: Were happy to participate. PR contact is elliot@pulsecare.ai. Embargo ok for 2 weeks after webinar. Well confirm exact numbers live on the interview.

ben-legal: Good. Ill send a short consent template covering quote, logo, slide screenshots, and video. If they want edits, well iterate but need sign-off before publish.

leo-growth: Webinar title idea: "Scaling patient-facing LLMs: PulseCare + Redwood"  co-present with PulseCare Head of ML. Registration CTA: checkbox "Interested in Dedicated/Private deployment" and hidden enterprise intent field to route to AE.

sam-sales: Add an "ARR or contact me" hidden field so AEs can prioritize. Also tag the lead source as webinar-pulsecare in CRM.

yara-product: Also request a short appendix in the landing page with test methodology: sequence lengths, model variant, caching strategy, and traffic profile. Helps interpret the percent gains.

mira-marketing: Will build landing page draft at /marketing/case-studies/pulsecare. Draft social copy too but will use "reported" language until numbers are signed off.

kevin-cs: Uploaded dashboards and a short readme to the intake doc: https://docs.redwood/inbox/pulsecare-pilot (permissions updated).

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: PulseCare interview Thurs 9:30-10:00am PT. Invites: mira-marketing, kevin-cs, sam-sales, nora-pulsecare (guest), elliot-pulsecare (guest), ben-legal (optional).

mira-marketing: After the call Ill prepare two quote variants and circulate for legal sign-off. If numbers are confirmed on the call, well produce the metrics-forward case study + webinar slide deck within 48 hours.

ben-legal: Received. Ill mark the consent doc and lock comments until they sign. Keep me CCd on final copy.

nora-pulsecare: Sounds good  looking forward to the call.

calendar-bot: Reminder: PulseCare interview Thu 9:30am PT (in 2 days).
